content: Multi-tool network utility sites (networktools.dev, dnschecker.org/all-tools, coderstool.com, networkcheckr.com, webmandor.com) commonly bundle: subnet calculator, DNS lookup, MAC/OUI lookup, WHOIS, IP geolocation/ASN lookup, port checker, and reverse DNS -- all under one shared nav with no login. networktools.dev specifically markets 'no tracking, no accounts, no data collection' as its core positioning, directly matching this brief's differentiation goal. Common gap across these sites: cluttered layouts, ad-heavy pages (subnet-calculator.com flagged as bad example), and inconsistent single-purpose focus -- this brief's minimal/no-ads/keyboard-first approach is a real differentiator versus the incumbent field.
